newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan LTCB, NCB cut long-term prime rate to 3.0%.
newsitem.headline: Japan LTCB, NCB cut long-term prime rate to 3.0%.

text.p: The Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd and Nippon Credit Bank said separately on Tuesday that they had decided to cut their long-term prime rates by 0.3 percent point to 3.0 percent, effective from Wednesday.
The two banks also said they had cut their debenture coupon rates for September issues by the same margin of 0.3 percent point, they also said.
The LTCB debenture, to be issued this month will carry a coupon of 2.3 percent, compared with 2.6 percent in the past three months.
The NCB debentures will have a coupon rate of 2.55 percent, compared with 2.85 percent in the past three months.
